notes.tech: Thread proposed 1 (2026-10-11): "techno fabric" (100% polyester) and "technical wool" (53/47 virgin wool-polyester) on tailoring co-ords; "water-repellent taffeta" (67/33 polyester-cotton); coated denim; padded nylon (polyamide) outerwear; no named membrane, insulation or performance fibre — NONE: no owned or licensed membrane, insulation or performance fibre named on any of 101 men's clothing styles; share of range 0 of 101 styles name an owned or licensed technology; 10 of 101 are synthetic-le. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): Marni states the country of making for every men's clothing style (101 of 101; Italy 73, Romania 19, Portugal 8, Albania 1) but names no maker, mill or owned workshop, and its own story page offers only 'artisanal workmanship' with no place or process. The 1994 founding is dated (Milan per OTB) but is design heritage, not making. A country on every label and nothing more is a 2. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: NONE claimed: marni.com Marni Story page speaks of "artisanal workmanship" without naming a place; OTB brand page says only "experimental craftsmanship techniques"; no factory or atelier named
craft_evidence.makers: no: none of 101 men's clothing styles names a factory, workshop or maker
craft_evidence.mills: no: "British suiting fabric, locally manufactured" (Gray British wool pants) and "Shetland wool" knits, but no cloth or yarn mill named on any read PDP
craft_evidence.madein: 101 of 101 men's clothing styles carry a country of making in the product data (Italy 73, Romania 19, Portugal 8, Albania 1); the PDP copy ends 'Made in ...' (checked on the satin trousers PDP), read 11 Oct
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, place not on brand page: marni.com says "Since its foundation in 1994"; OTB brand page says "founded in Milan in 1994"
craft_evidence.process: no: PDP copy names techniques (fisherman stitch, intarsia, openwork knit, raised stripes woven in with thick yarn) but the brand publishes no account of how or where its garments are made
craft_evidence.reasoning: Marni states the country of making for every men's clothing style (101 of 101; Italy 73, Romania 19, Portugal 8, Albania 1) but names no maker, mill or owned workshop, and its own story page offers only 'artisanal workmanship' with no place or process. The 1994 founding is dated (Milan per OTB) but is design heritage, not making. A country on every label and nothing more is a 2.

ownership.owner: OTB S.p.A. (Renzo Rosso), via Marni Group S.r.l.; OTB FY2025 results release (17 Feb 2026) lists Marni among OTB brands; creative director Meryll Rogge from July 2025
